events.notes: Three-day workshop on flexible ventricular neuroendoscopy for neurosurgeons, fellows and residents, supported by the Leon Pediatric Neuroscience Fund. Lectures and case discussions, a live surgery by the course director Samer K. Elbabaa, MD (chief of pediatric neurosurgery, Orlando Health Arnold Palmer Hospital for Children), and hands-on lab sessions with rigid and flexible endoscopes on anatomical models (no cadavers mentioned). Tracks and fees (registration page): Hands-on $1,195 (resident/fellow $995; limited places); Lecture only/live viewing, observer access to the lab, $750 (resident/fellow $550); Virtual $500 (resident/fellow $300). CME: the registration page says approved for AMA PRA Category 1 Credits; the events page says credits are being considered. Agenda coming soon. Registration: https://give.orlandohealth.com/event/the-third-flexible-ventricular-neuroendoscopy-live/e757518. Contact: ChildrensNeuroscienceEvents@OrlandoHealth.com
